issues.title: Missing meta description
issues.whyItMatters: The description is the grey text under your headline in Google. Without it, Google pulls random text from the page and fewer people click.
issues.howToFix: Add a <meta name="description"> of 70-160 characters that sells the page and includes the main keyword.

issues.title: Title is too short
issues.whyItMatters: A very short title wastes the most valuable spot in search results and rarely matches what people search for.
issues.howToFix: Expand the title to 30-60 characters: main keyword + what the page offers + brand.

issues.title: No structured data (schema.org)
issues.whyItMatters: Structured data helps Google show rich results (stars, prices, FAQs, breadcrumbs) and helps AI search understand the page.
issues.howToFix: Add JSON-LD for what the page is: Organization or LocalBusiness on the homepage, Article on posts, Product on product pages.

issues.title: Not set up for mobile (no viewport tag)
issues.whyItMatters: Google ranks the mobile version of your site. Without a viewport tag, phones show a shrunken desktop page.
issues.howToFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> inside <head>.

issues.title: Very little text on the page
issues.whyItMatters: Pages with only a few sentences rarely rank, because search engines cannot tell what they are about or why they are useful.
issues.howToFix: Add helpful text that answers what a visitor came for: details, FAQs, examples. Aim for 300+ words on pages you want to rank.

issues.title: Title is too short
issues.whyItMatters: A very short title wastes the most valuable spot in search results and rarely matches what people search for.
issues.howToFix: Expand the title to 30-60 characters: main keyword + what the page offers + brand.

issues.title: More than one H1 heading
issues.whyItMatters: Several main headlines blur what the page is about. Not an error, but one clear H1 is the best practice.
issues.howToFix: Keep one <h1> for the main headline and change the others to <h2> or <h3>.

issues.title: No canonical tag
issues.whyItMatters: Without a canonical, URL variants (tracking parameters, http/https, trailing slashes) can compete with each other in Google.
issues.howToFix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="..."> pointing at the page's own preferred URL. Most SEO plugins do this automatically.

issues.title: No structured data (schema.org)
issues.whyItMatters: Structured data helps Google show rich results (stars, prices, FAQs, breadcrumbs) and helps AI search understand the page.
issues.howToFix: Add JSON-LD for what the page is: Organization or LocalBusiness on the homepage, Article on posts, Product on product pages.

issues.title: Social share preview is incomplete
issues.whyItMatters: When the page is shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, X or in chat apps, missing Open Graph tags give a plain or broken preview and fewer clicks.
issues.howToFix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image (1200x630 image) plus twitter:card. Most SEO plugins have a "social" tab for this.

issues.title: Page language is not declared
issues.whyItMatters: The lang attribute helps search engines, translators and screen readers handle the page correctly.
issues.howToFix: Add a language to the html tag, for example <html lang="en">.

issues.title: No H1 heading
issues.whyItMatters: The H1 is the main headline on the page. It tells visitors and search engines what the page is about.
issues.howToFix: Add one <h1> near the top of the page that matches the page topic (it can be close to the title).

issues.title: Invalid hreflang language code
issues.whyItMatters: Google ignores hreflang tags with bad codes, so visitors may see the wrong language version.
issues.howToFix: Use ISO codes like "en", "en-US", "es-MX" or "x-default" in every hreflang tag.

issues.title: Meta description is too short
issues.whyItMatters: A short description gives searchers little reason to click and Google may replace it with page text.

issues.title: Server response could be faster
issues.detail: 1.5 s until the server answered (aim for under 0.8 s)
issues.whyItMatters: Pages that take over a second to arrive feel sluggish and leave less time budget for images and scripts.
issues.howToFix: Enable caching or a CDN. Check full speed with our Bulk PageSpeed Checker.
